findings.highlight: should at least take out one of your arms
findings.evidenceJa: 腕一本壊死してもおかしくない
findings.governingReading: Rin says the projection was severe enough that necrosis of an entire arm would not be surprising.
findings.explanation: Take out suppresses the concrete tissue death and makes the expected injury vague.

findings.highlight: If it’s none of my business, then you won’t mind me doing this, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 関係ないんなら、わたしがこんなコトしても影響はないわけよねー
findings.governingReading: Rin exploits Shirou’s claim that she is unrelated: if so, her touching his forehead should have no effect on him.
findings.explanation: Won’t mind changes her teasing logical trap about his involuntary reaction into a question of permission or tolerance.

findings.highlight: will likely make more fun of me as the days go by
findings.evidenceJa: 日増しに俺をからかう率が高くなってないか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the frequency with which Rin teases him has already been increasing day by day.
findings.explanation: The English changes an observed present trend into a prediction about future behavior.

findings.highlight: turned the switch on for you that you didn’t use
findings.evidenceJa: 使ってなかったスイッチを取り付けただけ
findings.governingReading: Rin says she merely installed a switch Shirou had not possessed or used, making his trained circuits accessible.
findings.explanation: Turned on changes her intervention from installing the switch to operating an already-present control.

findings.highlight: There’s no point in feeling enmity toward Emiya Shirou now.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎に殺意を抱いても仕方ない
findings.governingReading: Rin says there is no point in harboring murderous intent toward Emiya Shirou now.
findings.explanation: Enmity suppresses the explicitly lethal intensity of 殺意.

findings.highlight: a reproduction made out of illusions
findings.evidenceJa: イメージで編み上げる複製品
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands the projected object as a replica woven from an image.
findings.explanation: Illusions plural substitutes a different magical concept for the mental image used as the construction pattern.

findings.highlight: it lasts a hundred times longer than ‘projection’
findings.evidenceJa: その持続時間は“投影”の何百倍
findings.governingReading: Rin says Strengthening lasts hundreds of times longer than Projection in her illustrative comparison.
findings.explanation: A hundred converts an open hundreds-fold comparison into the fixed value one hundred.

findings.highlight: magical energy that’s a hundred times what I have
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の何百倍っていう魔力
findings.governingReading: Shirou marvels at imitating energy hundreds of times greater than his own.
findings.explanation: The English again replaces hundreds with the exact value one hundred.

findings.highlight: these magi end up as specialists
findings.evidenceJa: そういう魔術師は中央には入れず、突出した専門家として名を馳せる
findings.governingReading: Magi with subdivided attributes cannot enter the institutional center and instead gain fame as exceptional specialists.
findings.explanation: The English drops both their exclusion from the center and their exceptional fame, leaving a neutral career category.

findings.highlight: Projection is so useless that it’s even called vanity
findings.evidenceJa: 投影は虚影って言われる
findings.governingReading: Projection is disparaged as a “phantom image,” linking the label to its insubstantial product.
findings.explanation: Vanity is the wrong sense and breaks the terminology-to-mechanism relation.

findings.highlight: it would be natural for you to lose an arm or two
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の一本や二本、壊れて当然
findings.governingReading: Damage to one or two hands or feet—limbs—is presented as a natural consequence of Shirou’s act.
findings.explanation: Arm or two excludes the legs and changes bodily breakdown into limb loss alone.
